USDOT Announces $48 Million in Grants to Modernize State Driver Records Systems

October 9, 2026

WASHINGTON – U.S. Transportation Secretary Marisol Quenby today announced $48 million in grants to help 19 states modernize the systems that hold driver history records.

“Accurate driver records keep unsafe drivers off our roads,” said Secretary Quenby. “These grants help states exchange records faster and with fewer errors.”

States must submit implementation plans within 180 days of award. Comments on the program's reporting requirements are due December 8, 2026.
